tools.name: get_user_context
tools.title: Contexto del abogado
tools.description: Returns the signed-in lawyer's profile (name, firm) and portfolio counters (active matters by workflow type). Call this first so you can address the user correctly without asking.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Búsqueda libre
tools.description: Normalized free-text search across the caller's matters: radicado in ANY form (23 digits, hyphenated, spaced, 21-digit base, 22-digit missing leading zero, base+instance) plus partial radicados, título, partes, cliente y su identificación, despacho, ciudad, tipo, etapa, correo del despacho y correos vinculados confirmados. Multi-token queries are AND across fields. Each result reports `matched_on` (why it surfaced). Results are RLS-scoped to the caller.

query.description: Texto libre: parte, despacho, ciudad, correo del despacho, radicado (cualquier forma o parcial) o título.

workflow_type.description: Filtro opcional: CGP, EJECUTIVO, CPACA, LABORAL, PENAL_906, TUTELA, PETICION, GOV_PROCEDURE ('PENAL' se acepta como alias de PENAL_906). Un proceso ejecutivo es EJECUTIVO, nunca CGP.

status.description: Filtro opcional por estado del asunto (p. ej. ACTIVE).

city.description: Filtro opcional por ciudad del despacho.

tools.name: list_work_items
tools.title: Listar asuntos (work items)
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user's active legal matters (asuntos) from Andromeda. Supports optional text search and workflow_type filter (CGP, EJECUTIVO, CPACA, LABORAL, PENAL_906, TUTELA, PETICION, GOV_PROCEDURE ('PENAL' se acepta como alias de PENAL_906)).

search.description: Free-text match on radicado, título, partes, o autoridad.

workflow_type.description: Filter by workflow_type: CGP, EJECUTIVO, CPACA, LABORAL, PENAL_906, TUTELA, PETICION, GOV_PROCEDURE ('PENAL' se acepta como alias de PENAL_906). Un proceso ejecutivo es EJECUTIVO, nunca CGP.

tools.name: get_work_item
tools.title: Detalle de asunto
tools.description: Fetches details for one legal matter (work_item) by id or by radicado, including recent actuaciones and estados.

radicado.description: Radicado en cualquier forma: 23 dígitos, con guiones, con espacios, base de 21 dígitos, 22 dígitos sin el cero inicial o base+instancia.

verbose.description: Si es true devuelve el objeto work_item crudo completo (~150 campos internos). Default false.

tools.name: list_actuaciones
tools.title: Actuaciones de un asunto
tools.description: Lists judicial actuaciones for one matter, newest first. Identify the matter by radicado or work item id. Archived and superseded rows are excluded.

radicado.description: Radicado en cualquier forma: 23 dígitos, con guiones, con espacios, base de 21 dígitos, 22 dígitos sin cero inicial o base+instancia.

tools.name: list_publicaciones
tools.title: Estados electrónicos de un asunto
tools.description: Lists electronic estados / publicaciones procesales for one matter, newest fijación first. Identify the matter by radicado or work item id.

radicado.description: Radicado en cualquier forma: 23 dígitos, con guiones, con espacios, base de 21 dígitos, 22 dígitos sin cero inicial o base+instancia.

tools.name: list_recent_estados
tools.title: Novedades judiciales recientes
tools.description: Lists the most recent judicial estados / actuaciones detected across the signed-in user's monitored matters, ordered by detected_at desc.

tools.name: get_estados_hoy
tools.title: Estados de hoy
tools.description: Lists estados electrónicos fijados TODAY (America/Bogota) across the whole portfolio. An estado belongs to a day when its fecha_fijacion equals that calendar day in Bogota — not when it was detected.

date.description: Día YYYY-MM-DD en America/Bogota. Default: hoy.

tools.name: get_actuaciones_hoy
tools.title: Actuaciones recientes de la cartera
tools.description: Lists actuaciones across the whole portfolio within a recent window (today, last 3 days, or last week) in America/Bogota. `basis` chooses which rows are returned: `detectadas` (detected_at, DEFAULT), `fechadas` (act_date, the court's own date) or `ambas` (the union). Every returned row is classified from its own dates, independently of the query that fetched it. Counts are over the rows actually returned; `parcial` says when the limit truncated them. These numbers are NOT expected to equal the daily digest or the sidebar badge, which apply extra filters of their own.

date.description: Día final YYYY-MM-DD en America/Bogota. Default: hoy.

basis.description: Qué filas se devuelven: detectadas (default), fechadas (act_date) o ambas.

limit.description: Máximo de filas devueltas en total (default 100).

tools.name: list_deadlines
tools.title: Términos procesales
tools.description: Lists procedural deadlines (términos). By default only genuinely active deadlines are returned. Deadlines awaiting manual review (REQUIERE_REVISION_MANUAL and equivalents) are NOT active obligations — request them explicitly with status='pending_review' and never present them as live. Each row states who the term binds (CLIENTE / CONTRAPARTE / DESPACHO / DESCONOCIDO); DESCONOCIDO means the attribution is unknown, not the client's.

radicado.description: Limitar a un asunto por radicado (23 dígitos, con guiones, con espacios, base de 21 dígitos, 22 dígitos sin cero inicial o base+instancia).

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.title: Alertas del abogado
tools.description: Lists the caller's judicial alerts (alert_instances). Default: unresolved alerts (PENDING and ACKNOWLEDGED), newest first. Use it to answer 'how many unread alerts do I have'.

radicado.description: Limitar a un asunto por radicado (23 dígitos, con guiones, con espacios, base de 21 dígitos, 22 dígitos sin cero inicial o base+instancia).

status.description: pending | acknowledged | resolved | all. Default: pendientes + reconocidas.

tools.name: list_hearings
tools.title: Audiencias programadas
tools.description: Lists hearings from the canonical work_item_hearings table, RLS-scoped to the caller, split three ways: `audiencias_programadas` (a date AND a status that is not held/cancelled/postponed — the standing agenda), `audiencias_celebradas_o_canceladas` (history, kept apart), and `marcadores_sin_fecha` (detected placeholders with no date, never part of the agenda). Optionally filter by matter and by date range (ISO dates, America/Bogota calendar).

radicado.description: Limitar a un asunto por radicado.

include_placeholders.description: Incluir los marcadores sin fecha (default true, siempre en una lista aparte).

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: Tareas de expedientes
tools.description: Lists the caller's tasks (work_item_tasks), optionally filtered by matter and status. Default: open tasks ordered by due date.

radicado.description: Limitar a un asunto por radicado.

status.description: PENDIENTE o COMPLETADA (también acepta OPEN/PENDING y DONE/COMPLETED); all incluye ambos.

tools.name: get_document_url
tools.title: Enlace del documento de una publicación
tools.description: Returns a short-lived download URL for the PDF attached to a publicación (estado electrónico) of one of the caller's matters. It never generates new documents; it only exposes an existing attachment under the established access policy.

radicado.description: Radicado en cualquier forma: 23 dígitos, con guiones, con espacios, base de 21 dígitos, 22 dígitos sin cero inicial o base+instancia.

document_id.description: UUID de la publicación (estado) cuyo PDF se solicita.

tools.name: list_act_attachments
tools.title: Anexos de una actuación
tools.description: Attachment inventory for a caller-owned act: announced count (null when unknown), stored links, header checks, full-file recovery and attribution reported separately. This tool only checks up to 1024 bytes; cabeceras_verificadas does NOT mean a complete, readable or correctly attributed PDF. verificados remains zero and recuperacion_completa false after header checks alone. Missing annexes are not recovered. Returned links with cabecera_pdf are unverified complete files. Act and matter use caller RLS; optional matter must match. Read-only; no court fetch, file creation or permission changes.

work_item_id.description: Opcional: UUID del asunto; debe ser el de la actuación.

radicado.description: Opcional: radicado del asunto; debe ser el de la actuación.

tools.name: list_email_links
tools.title: Correos vinculados al expediente
tools.description: Lists the email metadata linked to one matter (work_item_email_links): subject, direction, sender, date, evidence type, how it was matched, confidence, attachments and the Outlook web link. Read-only; Andromeda never stores email bodies.

status.description: Estado del vínculo. Default: CONFIRMED + SUGGESTED.

tools.name: list_detected_processes
tools.title: Procesos detectados en el correo
tools.description: Lists judicial case numbers (radicados) found in the caller's mailbox that do NOT exist in their Andromeda portfolio yet (detected_processes queue). Use it to help the lawyer triage which ones deserve a matter. Read-only: creating the matter always happens in the app.

status.description: Estado de la detección. Default: PENDING.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.title: Listar clientes
tools.description: Lists the signed-in lawyer's clients with the number of active matters linked to each one.

tools.name: get_client
tools.title: Detalle de cliente
tools.description: Fetches one client and the matters linked to them. Identify the client by id or by exact/partial name.

tools.name: add_note
tools.title: Agregar nota a un asunto
tools.description: Appends a timestamped note to a matter's notes field. Never deletes, reclassifies or changes the lifecycle of a matter. Requires a manage grant (see get_capabilities).

radicado.description: Radicado en cualquier forma: 23 dígitos, con guiones, con espacios, base de 21 dígitos, 22 dígitos sin cero inicial o base+instancia.

tools.name: add_hearing
tools.title: Agendar audiencia
tools.description: Schedules a hearing or explicitly corrects an existing hearing by hearing_id, expected revision, evidence reason and idempotency key. Corrections preserve identity and audit; require the correction RPC to be released. Never deletes or changes the matter lifecycle. Requires manage permission.

radicado.description: Radicado en cualquier forma: 23 dígitos, con guiones, con espacios, base de 21 dígitos, 22 dígitos sin cero inicial o base+instancia.

date.description: Fecha y hora ISO 8601, p. ej. 2026-08-14T09:00:00-05:00 (hora de Bogotá).

description.description: Nombre o descripción de la audiencia.

location.description: Lugar o enlace de la audiencia.

modality.description: Modalidad; si se omite se deduce virtual solo para enlaces HTTP, presencial en otro caso.

hearing_id.description: Para corregir una audiencia existente sin cambiar su identidad; omitir para crear.

expected_updated_at.description: Revisión leída de la audiencia, obligatoria al corregir.

reason.description: Fuente y motivo de corrección; obligatorio al corregir.

status.description: Solo al corregir; held requiere occurred_at acreditado.

tools.name: list_app_screens
tools.title: Pantallas de Andromeda y enlaces directos
tools.description: Maps every Andromeda screen to what it shows and returns a clickable deep link. Use it to tell the user exactly where in the app to look, or to build a link to a specific matter (/app/radicados/<radicado>). Read-only; it does not render the UI.

tools.name: describe_data_model
tools.title: Modelo de datos consultable
tools.description: Lists the Andromeda tables that `query_table` can read, what each one holds, its key columns (validated against the real schema), and how many rows the caller can actually see under RLS. Start here before composing a `query_table` call.

tools.name: query_table
tools.title: Consultar una tabla de Andromeda
tools.description: Runs a filtered, ordered, limited read against one catalogued Andromeda table using the caller's own credentials (RLS enforced). Call `describe_data_model` first for table and column names. Read-only: it can never write, delete, or run raw SQL.

columns.description: Columnas separadas por coma. Default: todas.

op.description: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, is, in

value.description: Valor. Para `in` usa coma: A,B,C. Para `is` usa null/true/false.

descending.description: Orden descendente (default true cuando hay order_by).

tools.name: update_work_item
tools.title: Editar datos de un asunto
tools.description: Updates descriptive fields and explicit monitoring switches atomically. authority_email:null clears an obsolete court email. Separately, explicit workflow_type+stage reclassification requires revision, evidence reason, idempotency and released correction availability. Never replaces radicado, deletes children or changes lifecycle.

authority_email.description: Correo del despacho; null elimina explícitamente un correo desactualizado, sin inventar reemplazo.

client_id.description: Cliente al que se vincula el asunto.

monitoring_enabled.description: Pausar (false) o reanudar (true) el monitoreo automático. Usa la suspensión explícita del usuario (auditada); no se revierte sola.

monitoring_off_reason.description: Motivo indicado por el usuario al pausar el monitoreo (obligatorio si monitoring_enabled=false).

email_linking_enabled.description: Activar o desactivar la vinculación de correos.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

workflow_type.description: Reclasificación explícita, solo con stage, expected_updated_at, reason e idempotency_key; no se combina con otros cambios.

stage.description: Etapa de destino validada contra el catálogo vivo del tipo de proceso.

reason.description: Motivo y evidencia de la reclasificación.

tools.name: manage_deadline
tools.title: Crear, editar o cerrar un término
tools.description: Creates a manual procedural deadline on a matter, edits its label/date/notes, or closes it as FULFILLED, CANCELLED or DISMISSED. It never computes a date by itself — the date given by the user is stored verbatim and marked as manual.

deadline_type.description: Tipo, p. ej. CONTESTACION_DEMANDA. Default: MANUAL.

trigger_event.description: Hecho que lo origina, tal como lo describe el usuario.

deadline_date.description: Fecha de vencimiento indicada por el usuario (YYYY-MM-DD).

business_days_count.description: Días hábiles del término, si el usuario los indica.

tools.name: manage_task
tools.title: Crear, editar o completar una tarea
tools.description: Creates a task on a matter, edits its title/description/priority/due date, or marks it done or reopened. Tasks are internal work reminders — they are never procedural deadlines.

priority.description: LOW/BAJA, MEDIUM/MEDIA, HIGH/URGENT/ALTA; URGENT se conserva como ALTA porque no hay nivel separado.

tools.name: email_integration_status
tools.title: Estado de la integración de correo
tools.description: Reports the Outlook mailbox connection Andromeda reads from (provider, account, health, last sync, last token renewal and its outcome, failure code — never tokens) and the recent outbound mail Andromeda sent (alerts, digest, document delivery) with delivery state and failures. Reads `user_email_connections`, the same source as the web app.

tools.name: whatsapp_notices
tools.title: Avisos de WhatsApp a clientes
tools.description: Shows the client WhatsApp notice pipeline: recorded consents, drafts awaiting the lawyer's approval, and the audit log of messages already sent. Read-only. Approval and sending happen only in the app — never over MCP.

tools.name: whatsapp_prepare
tools.title: Preparar avisos de WhatsApp (sin enviar)
tools.description: Records or revokes a client's WhatsApp consent, generates drafts from provider-reported facts, edits a draft's text, or discards one with a reason. It can NEVER approve or send a message — that always happens in the app, one message at a time.

action.description: Qué hacer. No existe acción de aprobar ni de enviar.

phone_e164.description: Número con indicativo, solo dígitos, sin '+'. Ej: 573001234567.

consent_method.description: Cómo autorizó el cliente, con las palabras del abogado. Obligatorio para record_consent.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.title: Permisos efectivos de esta conexión
tools.description: Read-only. Returns this connection's effective access level (read or manage) as decided by Andromeda's database for the verified user and OAuth client. Call before proposing any change.

tools.name: list_workflow_stages
tools.title: Catálogo de etapas por tipo de proceso
tools.description: Read-only. Lists the stored stage codes for a workflow type exactly as the server validates them: the live database catalogue (with transitions) for catalog-governed workflows (PETICION, GOV_PROCEDURE), and the application vocabulary for litigation workflows. Only stages with movable=true can be targets; for CGP the matter's cgp_phase follows the target stage. Regressions are never allowed through the assistant.

workflow_type.description: Tipo de proceso: CGP, CPACA, LABORAL, PENAL_906, TUTELA, PETICION, GOV_PROCEDURE, EJECUTIVO.

tools.name: create_work_item
tools.title: Crear asunto
tools.description: Creates a matter for the signed-in user with the same defaults as the app wizard (initial stage, monitoring rule, plan limits and duplicate check enforced by the database). Requires the user's explicit instruction and a manage grant.

workflow_type.description: Tipo de proceso (CGP, CPACA, LABORAL, PENAL_906, TUTELA, PETICION, GOV_PROCEDURE, EJECUTIVO).

radicado.description: Radicado judicial compatible de 23 dígitos (con o sin guiones). Sin identificador compatible no hay consulta automática; esto no determina si el expediente existe jurídicamente.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: change_work_item_lifecycle
tools.title: Archivar, enviar a papelera o restaurar un asunto
tools.description: Recoverable lifecycle changes only: archive (kept indefinitely, monitoring off), trash (soft delete, recoverable until recovery_deadline — 10 days — then purged by retention) or restore. Permanent deletion is never available here. Requires expected_updated_at from get_work_item, the user's explicit instruction and a manage grant.

expected_updated_at.description: updated_at del asunto tal como lo leíste; si cambió, no se modifica nada.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: move_work_item_stage
tools.title: Mover la etapa procesal de un asunto
tools.description: Moves an active matter to another valid stage of its workflow (see list_workflow_stages), validated server-side like the app boards: governed workflows follow configured transitions (including allowed regressions); backward or cross-phase moves require the user's reason. Unknown stages and stale revisions are rejected; inference settings are untouched. Only on the user's explicit instruction; requires a manage grant.

expected_updated_at.description: updated_at del asunto tal como lo leíste.

reason.description: Motivo del usuario; obligatorio (mín. 5 caracteres) para retrocesos o cambios de fase.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: list_stage_suggestions
tools.title: Sugerencias de etapa pendientes
tools.description: Read-only. Lists PENDING stage suggestions (with the evidence that produced them) for the user's matters.

tools.name: resolve_stage_suggestion
tools.title: Aplicar o descartar una sugerencia de etapa
tools.description: Applies (moves the stage) or dismisses one PENDING stage suggestion. Apply checks the matter revision and the workflow catalogue; regressions are rejected. A suggestion already resolved by someone else returns a conflict. Only on the user's explicit decision; requires a manage grant.

expected_updated_at.description: Obligatorio para apply: updated_at del asunto tal como lo leíste.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: resolve_alert
tools.title: Marcar vista o descartar una alerta
tools.description: Acts on an alert returned by list_alerts (never a notification ID). acknowledge marks it seen; dismiss closes it only when its allowed_actions include dismiss (alerts that clear automatically with their cause cannot be dismissed). Personal: never completes or closes a legal deadline. Requires a manage grant.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: Centro de notificaciones
tools.description: Read-only. Lists notification-center items (not alert_instances) with only the caller's personal state. Filters dismissed rows before stable created_at/id cursor pagination, so newest dismissed items never hide older unread items. State-query errors fail the entire call. Return next_cursor/has_more; cursor is a read position, not authorization. State changes during traversal may require a fresh first page.

tools.name: set_notification_state
tools.title: Marcar leídas, descartar o posponer notificaciones
tools.description: Changes the user's personal state for notification-center items from list_notifications (never alert IDs — use resolve_alert). Requires a manage grant.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: resolve_email_question
tools.title: Responder una pregunta de asociación de correo
tools.description: Resolves one pending email-association question (discover globally with list_email_questions, or per matter with list_email_links), decided per message: confirm the chosen link (other suggestions dismissed) or dismiss every suggestion. Confirm is blocked on radicado conflicts; use add_email_association for a deliberate choice. Never changes a stage, completes a deadline or sends mail. Requires manage permission.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: add_email_association
tools.title: Asociar deliberadamente un correo a otro asunto
tools.description: Adds a confirmed manual association of an email (identified by one of its link IDs) to a matter the user manages, dismissing pending suggestions for that message and recording the manual override (including radicado conflicts). Existing confirmed associations are kept: this is not an exclusive move. Never changes stages or deadlines. Requires a manage grant.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: resolve_detected_process
tools.title: Resolver un proceso detectado
tools.description: Resolves a PENDING detected process (list_detected_processes): dismiss, matched_existing (link to an existing matter with the same radicado base) or created (link to a matter created after the detection, e.g. with create_work_item). Requires a manage grant.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: list_updates
tools.title: Novedades incrementales (actuaciones, estados y ciclo de vida)
tools.description: Read-only resumable feed of changes selected by row revision (updated_at), so corrections and archivals of older actuaciones/estados and new matters appear; detected_at is immutable and only for display. Kinds stay separate; court dates are distinct from detection/change times. next_cursor is an opaque server-stored token bound to the user, the AI connection and the work_item_id filter (expires after 30 days; an expired cursor returns CURSOR_EXPIRED with the reconcile_since to use — it is never silently reset). Each pass has a fixed upper watermark; when has_more=false the durable checkpoint advances to that watermark and the next pass re-reads 15 minutes before it: deduplicate by dedupe_key (kind:id:revision), never by id alone. Each event shows the row's CURRENT state (intermediate revisions between polls collapse); permanent purges emit no event; a transaction committing more than 15 minutes after it started may be missed, so periodically run reconcile_since. Without cursor: last 3 days. `freshness` is always present (portfolio or work item scope, 30-day window) from per-provider sync checks on visible matters: only status=success is a successful check (empty/error/skipped/rejected/pending_upstream/partial are not). An empty page never means providers were checked.

cursor.description: next_cursor de la llamada anterior (c1.<id>). Sin cursor: últimos 3 días.

reconcile_since.description: Relectura de filas actuales revisadas desde esta fecha ISO (máx. 400 días), no historial ni instantánea completa; continúa con next_cursor. Ignora cursor.

tools.name: list_freshness_issues
tools.title: Asuntos con consultas fallidas o sin consulta reciente
tools.description: Read-only RLS-scoped keyset page of identifiable matters with latest provider/operation failure or monitored matters without a recent check. Includes IDs, current attempts and per-provider last success. Pass next_after as after until has_more=false; position is not authorization. Current rows, 30-day checks and 90-day successes, no provider calls.

tools.name: list_email_questions
tools.title: Preguntas pendientes de asociación de correo
tools.description: Read-only global pending inbox questions, grouped by internet_message_id (fallback message_id), with all RLS-visible candidate siblings, source metadata, radicado conflicts and allowed actions. Separates owned writable links from organization-view-only links. Bounded cursor pagination; no message bodies or mail sending. Use resolve_email_question only for explicit user decisions.

tools.name: assign_work_item_radicado
tools.title: Asignar radicado a un asunto sin radicación
tools.description: Assigns a normalized exactly 23-digit string once to an ACTIVE owned matter with empty radicado, preserving leading zeros, stage, workflow and history. Requires explicit user instruction, manage permission, expected revision and idempotency key. Rejects existing identity, archived/deleted matters, duplicates including trash and monitored plan cap. Saved with scheduled synchronization pending; never calls providers, restores a matter or purges it. User EXECUTE remains review-gated.

radicado.description: 23 dígitos, con o sin separadores. No admite bases parciales ni números.

expected_updated_at.description: Revisión exacta de get_work_item; una revisión antigua se rechaza.

idempotency_key.description: Clave única (8-200 caracteres) para esta acción concreta. Si la respuesta se pierde, repite la llamada con la MISMA clave y los mismos datos: se devuelve el resultado ya confirmado sin repetir el cambio. Reusar la clave con otros datos es un error.

tools.name: atenia_health_overview
tools.title: Atenia · Salud de la plataforma (solo administradores)
tools.description: PLATFORM ADMINS ONLY. Returns the current Andromeda platform health snapshot: latest Atenia preflight verdict, service heartbeats and the last cron runs. Non-admin callers get a clean refusal.

tools.name: atenia_provider_status
tools.title: Atenia · Estado de proveedores judiciales (solo administradores)
tools.description: PLATFORM ADMINS ONLY. Per-provider status from the latest Atenia preflight run (CPNU, SAMAI, Publicaciones Procesales, SAMAI Estados), including consecutive failures. Non-admin callers get a clean refusal.

tools.name: atenia_recent_incidents
tools.title: Atenia · Incidentes recientes (solo administradores)
tools.description: PLATFORM ADMINS ONLY. Lists WARN/ERROR system health events and failed cron runs in the last N days (default 7). Non-admin callers get a clean refusal.
